answer: A pre-written answer bank hence goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 90 aliases trips the duplicate check at the bridge gate. The lagoon receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a reef seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. Honest users pay that once, farms 35 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
